Name: Rose's Un-nerf Crop Prices
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
This mod changes the Price of Starfruit, Ancient Fruit, Blueberries, and Cranberries back to original pre-1.1 prices. Best Part it is modular, i code a 
configurable settings so you can pick what crops get back their original prices. 


Price Changes
[list]
[*]Changes Starfruit Price from 750g to 800g
[*]Changes Ancient Fruit Price from 550g to 750g
[*]Changes Blueberry Price from 50g to 80g
[*]Changes Cranberries Price from 75g to 130g
[/list](This mod was inspired by Sweet[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16129?tab=description] Un-nerfed Crop Value[/url] )(This Mod was made for 1.5 I remade it for 1.6 and added an Config Menu.)
(For these wondering what texture i am using in the photos, i am using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18769]DSHi Shipping Items Retexture[/url] by birDfiSHi)

[b]Also, Please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]
